learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to analyze automation technology tasks from industrial practice and systematically develop solutions.
Knowledge about modern computer-aided measurement and automation systems will be acquired.
Students are qualified to design and evaluate automation technology systems.

syllabus_topics: Introduction (basic concepts, standards, examples, goal of the lecture)
General requirements for automation devices (real-time capability, safety, robustness)
Actuators and sensors, specifics of process measurement technology
Formal description of controller functionality (input languages according to IEC 1131-3, programmable logic controllers (PLCs), introduction to Petri nets)
Fundamentals of Industrial Communication, especially bus systems
assessment_rules: To pass the module, students must pass the module examination. The examination consists of a written exam or an oral exam, each with a preliminary examination requirement.
